upcoming.title: A Match To Remember ✨🏏
upcoming.desc:
What do you get when 46 enthusiastic children, a legendary cricket ground, and the thrill of an IPL match come together? An experience to remember! 💙🏏

In association with Reliance Foundation, Leo Club of Juhu organized a special outing for 46 children from Enrich Lives Foundation to watch the MI vs RR ESA Match LIVE at Wankhede Stadium. For many of them, it was their first opportunity to witness a live cricket match, turning every run, wicket, and celebration into a cherished memory. 🏟️✨

The excitement in the stadium was contagious as the children immersed themselves in the energy of the game, cheered for their favourite moments, and enjoyed an evening filled with happiness and wonder. Seeing their smiles made the experience just as meaningful for our volunteers. 💫

A heartfelt appreciation to our Project Heads, Leo Naman Solanki and Leo Urvashi Jain, whose efforts made this memorable experience possible! 💙👏✨

Yours in Leo Movement
Leo Hawra Sabir 
Digital Director, 
Leo Club of Juhu
